edit.description: the batch arm: one suite run, one base tree per distinct base
the batch context reaching the judge, and the gate's batches declaration

summary: over a batch the judge runs the suite once on the merged tree and proves each entry's tests[] red at that entry's own base, one base tree per distinct base
acceptance: a batch of entries sharing a base builds one base tree; entries with different bases build one each; every entry's named lines are proved green on the merged tree and red at its own base, and the judge declares batches so a batched merge reaches it
tests: the judge runs the suite once over a batch's merged tree
the judge builds one base tree per distinct base in a batch
each entry's named lines are proved red at that entry's own base
a base tree is laid over the union of the files the entries' lines name
the package's judge gate declares batches
notes: Without this the judge is the gate that holds every phase to one span per merge, so the batching it is blocked on buys nothing here. base-red still refuses rather than blaming a span.
